description: Header file defining the cSettings class for managing configuration settings stored in a JSON-like format, including file I/O operations and key-value management.

classes.name: cSettings
classes.description: Class for handling configuration settings stored in a JSON object, with methods for reading, writing, and managing key-value pairs.

methods.name: cSettings
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the settings object, creating a new file if it does not exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a given key.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to set a key's value with string, int, or bool types.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists and is non-empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a key-value pair from the settings.

methods.name: writeToFile
methods.description: Writes the current JSON data to the configuration file.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads configuration data from the file into the JSON object.
